observations.body: Paul recites received claims about death, burial, resurrection, and appearances, naming Cephas before the Twelve.
observations.label: He appeared to Cephas

observations.body: The passage presents Receiving, delivering, and appearing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Receiving, delivering, and appearing

observations.body: The passage places Cephas named in the resurrection appearance sequence beside Receiving, delivering, and appearing.
observations.label: Cephas named in the resurrection appearance sequence

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 15:1–8 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul recites received claims about death, burial, resurrection, and appearances, naming Cephas before the Twelve. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: He appeared to Cephas
